name: Flowace
description_en:
Flowace combines automatic computer-time capture, workforce reporting and project/client allocation. It offers interactive or background deployment and configurable screenshots. Productive, neutral and unproductive categories can be set per team or individual.

Those classifications represent configured rules over observed activity, not a direct measurement of the value of work. The vendor’s savings and productivity percentages are not independently established in this documentation profile.
description_zh:
Flowace 结合电脑时间自动采集、劳动力报告及项目/客户分配，提供交互式或后台部署和可配置截图。有效、中性和无效分类可按团队或个人设置。

这些分类是对活动应用配置规则，不直接衡量工作价值。本文文档研究未独立证明厂商的节省及生产力百分比。

core_features.explanation_en: Associate captured time with projects/tasks and reporting.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将采集时间关联到项目/任务及报告。

core_features.explanation_en: Define productive/neutral/unproductive rules for the relevant team.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为相应团队定义有效/中性/无效规则。

en: Prepare teams, project/task definitions, app categories and billing rates before deploying the agent. Compare an ordinary work period, a private task and an offline activity with the resulting report. Define correction and review before converting project totals into an invoice; an automatic classification can be wrong for a particular role. No agent or invoice was tested.
zh: 部署代理前准备团队、项目/任务、应用分类及费率。将正常工作、私人事务及线下活动与结果报告对照。项目总额转发票前应有更正与审查，自动分类可能不适合某个角色。本次未测试代理或发票。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: Per-user annual/monthly paid tiers and custom Enterprise; a seven-day trial is distinct from sustained free use.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Per-user annual/monthly paid tiers and custom Enterprise; a seven-day trial is distinct from sustained free use.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 按用户年付/月付及定制 Enterprise；七天试用不同于长期免费。

official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: review hours assigned to a client
sections.title_zh: 示例：审查分配给客户的工时
sections.en:
Prepare teams, project/task definitions, app categories and billing rates before deploying the agent. Compare an ordinary work period, a private task and an offline activity with the resulting report. Define correction and review before converting project totals into an invoice; an automatic classification can be wrong for a particular role. No agent or invoice was tested.

Choose interactive or background collection deliberately and explain scope/access to affected staff. A busy application window is not sufficient evidence of completed deliverables.
sections.zh:
部署代理前准备团队、项目/任务、应用分类及费率。将正常工作、私人事务及线下活动与结果报告对照。项目总额转发票前应有更正与审查，自动分类可能不适合某个角色。本次未测试代理或发票。

应主动选择交互或后台采集，并向相关人员说明范围/访问。应用窗口忙碌不足以证明交付已完成。

sections.en:
The annual USD view lists Basic $1.99, Standard $3.99 and Premium $7 per user monthly equivalent, with Enterprise custom. Basic lists automatic attendance, screenshots and background tracking; higher plans add deeper activity/project analysis. Currency/cadence controls and extra charges need checkout confirmation.

The homepage offers a seven-day trial with no card. That is not a permanent Free plan. Do not normalize vendor headline ROI into the subscription cost or assume every integration/onboarding task is included without a scoped offer.
sections.zh:
USD 年付视图列 Basic 每用户月均 $1.99、Standard $3.99、Premium $7，Enterprise 定制。Basic 列自动考勤、截图及后台追踪，更高档增加活动/项目分析。货币/周期控制及额外费需结算确认。

首页提供无需卡的七天试用，不是永久免费档。不能把厂商 ROI 宣传折算进订阅成本，也不能未经范围报价认定包含所有集成/入门工作。

sections.title_en: Correction and access before financial use
sections.title_zh: 财务使用前明确更正及访问
sections.en:
Operations teams can evaluate the automatic time-to-project chain. A personal focus tool or a payroll provider is a different scope. After a gap, inspect client state, capture policy and sync before classifying it as lost labor; reconcile exports before billing.

The service describes managed reporting with an installed agent. No privacy/role enforcement, export completeness, paid invoice, software licence, self-hosted rights or restoration was verified. Certification/accuracy claims remain vendor statements, not a completed audit.
sections.zh:
运营团队可评估自动时间到项目的链路，个人专注工具或工资支付服务属于不同范围。出现间隔后，应先查客户端、采集政策及同步，再判定是否漏记劳动；计费前核对导出。

服务介绍安装代理及托管报告，未核实隐私/角色执行、导出完整性、付费发票、软件许可、自托管权或恢复。认证/准确性仍是厂商陈述，不是已完成审计。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: No agent, categorization, policy enforcement, invoice, integration, licence or recovery tested; final quote unknown.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试代理、分类、政策执行、发票、集成、许可或恢复；最终报价未知。
